stories.title: Brewers Are World Series Champions — Cubs' Rival Won It All

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
WORLD SERIES CHAMPIONS. Milwaukee.

The team that knocked the Cubs out in October just raised the bar for the entire NL Central — first title in 57 years of Brewers baseball.

Jed Hoyer, get a rotation. Now.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Michael King — Free Agency Opens Tomorrow, Cubs Must Pounce

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
MICHAEL KING. Free agent. Starting tomorrow.

King officially opted out of his Padres deal: 3.21 ERA, 185 innings, 32 starts in 2026. Projected at 4 years, $118M on the open market.

The Cubs' rotation is in ruins. This is the move.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: PCA BBWAA — NL MVP Finalists Announced Monday

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
MONDAY. The BBWAA announces NL MVP finalists.

Pete Crow-Armstrong — 45 HR, 41 SB, .372 OBP, MLB-best WAR — already won the MLBPA's Player of the Year Award.

The writers are next. This one's been over since June.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: Cubs Rotation Empty — Five Arms, All Gone

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
FIVE ARMS. All gone.

Imanaga, Gausman, Peterson, Boyd, Holmes — every key piece of the Cubs' 2026 pitching staff is hitting free agency this week. Cade Horton is out until at least mid-2027.

Jed Hoyer has one job this winter. Go get pitchers.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

stories.title: Seiya Suzuki Expected to Decline QO — Five-Year Run Ending

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
SEIYA SUZUKI. The qualifying offer is coming.

Cubs expected to extend a $23.15M QO this week — and Suzuki is projected to decline it. Five seasons, .270 BA, 26 HRs, career-best 5.1 WAR in 2026.

Chicago gets a comp pick either way.

#Cubs #MLB #ChicagoCubs
